title: Why are so many Indian buildings half-built for years? 4.8 lakh homes stuck
description:
Many unfinished towers in Indian cities are stalled housing projects. By May 2022 about 4.8 lakh homes in the top 7 cities were stuck or badly delayed (Anarock), and in fully stalled projects about two thirds of the flats were already sold. Loans run 3 to 4 years, projects take 7 to 8, the money runs out, then cases and insolvency follow. The SWAMIH fund finished about 61,000 homes by Dec 2025.
Sources: Anarock via PTI (Jun 2022), Liases Foras via Business Standard (Sep 2022), Ministry of Finance (Jan 2026). Educational content, not advice.
